comment: Advisories consciously accepted for a bounded period. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry; audit-check.mjs fails once an entry expires, forcing a re-review rather than letting exceptions linger.

allow.reason: RSC-mode CSRF bypass. Dropss is a client-side SPA using BrowserRouter with no React Server Components, no server actions and no SSR, so the affected code path is not present in the build. No fixed release exists: the advisory covers 7.12.0-8.2.0 while the fix for GHSA-337j-9hxr-rhxg requires >=7.18, and 7.18.1 is the latest published version. Downgrading to 7.11.0 would merely reinstate the other advisory.
allow.review: Drop this entry once react-router publishes a release above 8.2.0.
